title: 3Sum
hints: Fix the first number nums[i]; what remains is Two Sum for target -nums[i] on the rest. With a hash set that is already O(n^2), but removing duplicate triplets gets messy.
Sort first. For each i, run two pointers lo = i + 1 and hi = n - 1 inward: if the sum is too small move lo, if too large move hi. Sorted order makes each move safe.
Deduplicate by skipping: if nums[i] == nums[i - 1] continue, and after recording a triplet advance lo while nums[lo] == nums[lo - 1] (and hi likewise).
